step1_analysis.description: This circuit is a common-source amplifier stage with a PMOS current source load. Transistor XM2 acts as a diode-connected device to generate a bias voltage, which is typically mirrored to XM1 to provide an active load for the NMOS input transistor XM3.

paper_reference.title: A 250mV 7.5μW 61dB SNDR CMOS SC ΔΣ Modulator Using a Near-Threshold-Voltage-Biased CMOS Inverter Technique

power_consumption.description: Total static power dissipated by the circuit.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming a 10uA bias current is applied to N2 and mirrored to N4. Total current = 20uA. Power = 1.8V * 20uA = 36uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 nominal 1.8V supply and a standard 10uA bias current, which is much higher than the near-threshold 250mV operation in the paper.
Based on standard square-law approximations for SKY130 devices at 10uA bias.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency at which the open-loop voltage gain drops to 0 dB (1 V/V).

sky130_expected.calculation: UGF = gm3 / (2 * pi * Cload). With Cload = 1pF, UGF = 232uS / (2 * pi * 1pF) = 36.9 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the assumed load capacitance (1pF used for typical on-chip routing/next stage gate capacitance).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC operating point, power consumption, AC gain, and unity gain frequency. The circuit is self-biased using a large feedback resistor to ensure the output sits in the high-gain region.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Common-Source Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N4 N3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 N2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 N1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* Supplies and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
Ibias N2 0 10u
Vshort N3 N2 0

* Self-biasing feedback for high-gain region
Rfb N4 N1 10Meg
Cin in_ac N1 1u
Vac in_ac 0 DC 0 AC 1

* Load
Cload N4 0 1p

.control
* DC Operating Point and Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power
print v(N4)
print v(N1)

* AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 100 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(N4)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(N4))

meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=100
meas ac ugf when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_at_ugf find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 1n 2u

quit
.endc
.end
